notes: This administrative notice records a doctoral defense. The upper date is 20 octobre 1983. The candidate field reads SITOHANG Benhard and the subject is AUTOMATIQUE. The title and opening abstract call the system LINAIRE; the notice gives the defense as 28 OCTOBRE 1983 à 14h30 - CRIG USTL. Its abstract describes design and realization of a relational database management system on a microcomputer, then identifies BOUCLE MULTI-NIVEAUX, a multiple internal database structure, and adaptation of QUERY-BY-EXAMPLE as three areas of emphasis. These are statements reported from the notice; no technical performance or proof claim has been independently checked. The source spelling équi-joint and all visible capitals are preserved. The notice states 2 ans, names Monsieur le Professeur B. FILLIATRE as director and gives the five-person jury exactly as typed. The authorization retains P. le and the lower-case initial l of l’Attachée. The graphic signature stays alphabetically doubtful; the typed A. GENTIL below is clear. The whole scan and both prepared halves were inspected, followed by all twelve tight crops. Second-reading targets are localized to complete heading/entry baselines, the numbered paragraph starts, the complete signature and the marginal numeral; they do not use a broad central-page target. In the item_one crop, the final letter of a later context baseline reaches the crop boundary; the independent second-reading target is confined to the fully exposed first baseline. The three dash counts are transcription observations and are not mathematical check events. Blind audit: the three decorative rows retain their independently counted 12, 52 and 11 dashes. The signature drawing now preserves the small gaps in the low sweep and lower flourish; uncertain pale traces are unassigned and M0088 remains undecided.
